candidates.snippet: Melania Trump says the humanitarian mission in occupied Oleshky should become a starting point for lasting peace, with the ceasefire letting residents move freely and get food, clean water and medicine without constant shelling. https://t.co/as7VLwOhOW

Ukraine's General Staff says Ukrainian military evacuated 167 residents of the right bank of Kherson region during the humanitarian mission in Oleshky, among them 22 children and 21 low-mobility people, using the ceasefire on designated areas.
